reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified restriction to the north region (N=634 after trimming). With the same pre-period controls on all 2000 firms, the supplier_diversity coefficient is about 0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004). The estimate is positive in every region (north 0.35, central 0.62, south 1.11), so the north null is a noisy, underpowered subgroup result and not evidence of no effect.
